HESO 399.description: Investigation of readings and research undertaking topics of health and society, under the supervision of a faculty member with relevant expertise and experience. Restricted to students enrolled in the Minor in Health and Society program and with approval from the HESO Chair. Prerequisites: One of SPPH_V 301 or SOCI_V 284. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

HESO 400.description: Methods for analyzing population health data and medical research reporting.
